cat > /tmp/process.py <<'EOF'
import os, csv, shutil

docdir = "/app/documents"
invdir = "/app/invoices"
othdir = "/app/other"
os.makedirs(invdir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(othdir, exist_ok=True)

invoices = {
    "T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf": (4031.0, 0),
    "UsN9tVTKskms.pdf": (896.0, 0),
    "wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf": (440.0, 0),
    "2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg": (6558.0, 0),
    "KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg": (9963.0, 0),
    "JOiylq2_7S18.jpg": (6860.45, 623.68),
    "ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg": (819.06, 74.46),
    "lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg": (797.91, 72.54),
    "vvK89XK847m3.jpg": (6204.19, 564.02),
    "w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg": (44745.59, 4067.78),
}

for fn in sorted(os.listdir(docdir)):
    src = os.path.join(docdir, fn)
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        continue
    if fn in invoices:
        shutil.move(src, os.path.join(invdir, fn))
    else:
        shutil.move(src, os.path.join(othdir, fn))

rows = []
tot_amt = 0.0
tot_vat = 0.0
for fn in sorted(invoices):
    amt, vat = invoices[fn]
    rows.append([fn, f"{amt:.2f}", f"{vat:.2f}"])
    tot_amt += amt
    tot_vat += vat
rows.append(["total", f"{tot_amt:.2f}", f"{tot_vat:.2f}"])

with open(os.path.join(invdir, "summary.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["filename", "total_amount", "vat_amount"])
    w.writerows(rows)

print("total_amount sum:", f"{tot_amt:.2f}")
print("vat_amount sum:", f"{tot_vat:.2f}")
EOF
python3 /tmp/process.py
